name: react-native-matrix-crypto
description: A React Native bridge for Matrix cryptography

scripts.codegen: cargo build --quiet --manifest-path ../../rust/matrix-crypto-ffi/Cargo.toml && (cd ../../rust/matrix-crypto-ffi && ubrn generate jsi bindings ../target/debug/libmatrix_crypto_ffi.a --library --ts-dir ../../packages/react-native-matrix-crypto/src/generated --cpp-dir ../../packages/react-native-matrix-crypto/cpp/generated) && ubrn generate jsi turbo-module matrix_crypto --config ../../ubrn.config.yaml
